name: automatebrowser-extension
description: AutomateBrowser browser extension (Chrome/Edge) — WebSocket client that drives the active tab for the AutomateBrowser server.
_comment_axe-core: Pinned EXACT, and not imported by any source file. The extension ships public/vendor/axe.min.js — a verbatim copy of this package's build, because chrome.scripting.executeScript({files}) needs a standalone file. The dependency exists so `npm audit --omit=dev` and Dependabot watch the code we actually ship; tests/axe-version.test.ts fails if the copy and this version drift apart.
